protocol: Exp1: leak-free V3.5 + compliant-pair Procrustes handoff in stalk space from t>=0.5. Exp1b: classical pair estimators (compliant vs all, SO(d) vs GL(d), oracle two-map). Exp2: unlabeled IRLS/RANSAC on all pairs, classical and neural.

findings.interpretation: Oracle two-map energy remains 1.0 after the jump. SO(d) Procrustes on oracle-compliant pairs matches unlabeled Procrustes (~0.46-0.62, not 0.99): outliers are not the failure. GL(d) least squares on compliant pairs is 1.0: the post-jump relative map left SO(d) (additive jump ρ ← ρ+Δ). IRLS/RANSAC cannot recover it. Neural leak-free post-AUC 0.677; forcing handoff of those SO(d) maps lowers AUC (0.619-0.628). Fusion ingests the jump; the injected estimator is wrong.
